reasoning: The DB1.DE premise is falsified, not merely unfilled. I bought this structure on one sentence — the only name besides TKA where volume expands INTO the high rather than drying up at it. The two bars that printed since say the opposite: 08/28 made the new 52-week high close at 291.20 on 292,650 shares, the lightest of the four-day run, and 08/31 put 444,416 (1.43x the 311,187 average, heaviest of the run) into a DOWN close at 288.00 from a 290.20 open, with the 287.00 low breaking the 288.90 higher low that was rung ten of the ladder. Volume dried up at the high and expanded on the reversal. That is the IMI.L signature I called decoration in my own journal, and I am not going to hold a level whose reason for existing has been printed out of existence. If DB1 reclaims 291.80 on genuine expansion I will re-arm above it; the tape has to show me first.

ADM.L is done. Two consecutive distribution days with the second one larger, and the close now below the 40.52 and 40.60 lows that defined the last leg. The 41.40 level is 2.9% above a market that is being sold into strength; a buy-stop into that is hope with a limit price attached. No 08/31 bar because the LSE was shut for the bank holiday, so this name is one session stale — but 08/28 is decisive on its own and I would rather cancel now than let it sit armed into a Tuesday reopen I cannot see.
